statement: Akamai spent $346.5 million on capital expenditure in Q2 2026, equal to 32% of total company revenue, with $552.9 million for the first half, and gave no forward capex guidance in the retrievable text.
why: Spending a third of revenue on capital equipment shows how heavily a provider must invest up front to sell GPU capacity, which is money flowing toward accelerators and datacenters.

impact.mechanism: Elevated capital spending funds accelerator and facility purchases, feeding near-term demand for GPUs and datacenter capacity.

evidence.source: Akamai Technologies (official press release via GlobeNewswire)
evidence.excerpt: Capex: $346.5 million in Q2 2026 (32% of total company revenue) and $552.9 million for H1 2026 (25% of revenue) -- no forward capex guidance figure given in the retrievable text.

confidence.basis: Secondary-tier newswire release with capex level but no forward guidance; single source, so confidence capped at medium.
